name: Kokuin
source:
Kazuo just starts his career as a teacher. He works hard, and gradually becomes close to female students. One day, he has acute pain and is taken to hospital. After the medical checkup, he is diagnosed with incurable cancer. "I don't wanna be forgotten," he thinks. "I just wanna leave a proof of my life." He decides to leave a mark on each girl to prove his life. He sneaks out of the hospital, and heads for the girls....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081031144818/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005999]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
Kazuo刚刚开始他的教师生涯。他努力学习，逐渐和女学生走近了。有一天，他感到剧烈疼痛，被送往医院。体检后，他被诊断出患有无法治愈的癌症。“我不想被遗忘，”他想。“我只是想留下一个我活过的证据。”他决定在每个女孩身上留下印记，以证明他的一生。他偷偷溜出医院，向女孩们走去……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081031144818/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005999]工口游戏商店[/url]]
